findings.quote: `media_kind ('upload' | youtube | dropbox | gdrive | other — read the enum)`
findings.problem: PLAN §4 / DESIGN §4.1 define `media_kind` as `upload, youtube, dropbox, google_drive, url`. `gdrive` and `other` do not exist; the dispatcher rules and the table-test names would be built on wrong values.
findings.fix: Replace with `media_kind ('upload' | 'youtube' | 'dropbox' | 'google_drive' | 'url' — PLAN §4 enum)` and use `google_drive` / `url` wherever the prompt names a link kind (Build 3 rules, the test table, `players/External.tsx` provider label).

findings.quote: Read `packages/domain/src/media-links.ts` and `src/urls.ts` to see how the hosted YouTube embed URL is built (1.6b added a builder for `/embed/yt/<id>`)
findings.problem: G4 (1.6a/1.6b) fixes the names: `youtubeHostedEmbedPath(id) = '/embed/yt/' + id` in `media-links.ts` and `youtubeHostedEmbedUrl(appUrl, id) = appUrl + youtubeHostedEmbedPath(id)` in `urls.ts` (trailing slash trimmed); G8's 3.4b builds the page with `youtubeHostedEmbedUrl`. The prompt (and open_issues) treat the name as unknown and even allow the agent to add a second builder.
findings.fix: Name it: `hostedEmbedUrl = youtubeHostedEmbedUrl(publicEnv().webUrl, videoId)` from `@church/domain` `urls.ts`; delete the 'could not confirm / add it additively' sentences in Build 4, Build 7, notes and the open_issues entry; `hostedEmbedUrl.test.ts` only asserts the WebView source equals `youtubeHostedEmbedUrl(webUrl, id)` for a `webUrl` with and without a trailing slash.

findings.problem: G4 puts `SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS = 3600` and `SIGNED_URL_CACHE_MS = 50 * 60 * 1000` in `@church/domain` `src/limits.ts` (1.6a); `@church/db` exports `queryKeys`, `invalidationsFor`, `QUERY_STALE_TIME_MS`, `QUERY_GC_TIME_MS`, `SIGNED_URL_KEY_ROOT`, `shouldPersistQuery`. An agent importing the TTL constants from `@church/db` fails typecheck.
findings.fix: Move `SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS`, `SIGNED_URL_CACHE_MS` into the `@church/domain` sentence (`limits.ts`, 1.6a) and add `SIGNED_URL_KEY_ROOT`, `shouldPersistQuery(queryKey)` and `invalidationsFor` to the `@church/db` list.

findings.problem: G4 1.7a exports `shouldPersistQuery(queryKey): boolean` (false for `signedUrl` and `context` keys) and states 'step 4.1 passes it' to the persister. 4.1a instead invents a `meta.persist` convention that 4.2a must remember to set on every signed-URL query; the shared rule (and its unit tests) go unused and the `context` key gets persisted.
findings.fix: Write `shouldDehydrateQuery: (q) => q.state.status === 'success' && shouldPersistQuery(q.queryKey) && q.meta?.persist !== false` importing `shouldPersistQuery` from `@church/db`; document that `queryKeys.signedUrl(bucket, path)` (rooted at `SIGNED_URL_KEY_ROOT`) is therefore never persisted even without `meta`, and adjust the done_when bullet accordingly.

findings.problem: Same as 4.1a: those constants live in `@church/domain` `limits.ts` (G4 1.6a). Appears in Inputs (`constants SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS (3600) and SIGNED_URL_CACHE_MS (50 min)` under `@church/db`), Constraints and done_when.
findings.fix: Replace `@church/db` with `@church/domain` (`limits.ts`) for the two constants in Inputs, Constraints and done_when; keep `createSignedUrl` and `queryKeys` under `@church/db`.

findings.category: hedged names already fixed by other groups
findings.quote: If `queryKeys` has no signed-URL key, add `queryKeys.signedUrl(bucket, path)` additively in `packages/db/src/keys.ts` … `queryKeys.announcements.list(orgId, { feed: true })` … `queries/settings.ts` — the org settings reader (read the file for its name
findings.problem: G4 1.7a already defines `queryKeys.signedUrl(bucket, path)`, `queryKeys.announcements.feed(orgId)`, `queryKeys.bulletins.list(orgId)`, `queryKeys.bulletins.current(orgId, today)`, `queryKeys.settings(orgId)` and `getSettings(db, orgId)` in `queries/settings.ts`. The prompt invents a `{ feed: true }` filter key and tells the agent to guess the settings reader, so keys/invalidations diverge from the web app.
findings.fix: Use the exact names: feed query keyed `queryKeys.announcements.feed(orgId)`; current bulletin `queryKeys.bulletins.current(orgId, todayIso)`; list `queryKeys.bulletins.list(orgId)`; signed URL `queryKeys.signedUrl(bucket, path)` (exists — drop the 'if missing, add' clause and the HANDOFF deviation line); settings via `getSettings(supabase, orgId)` with `queryKeys.settings(orgId)`. Remove `queryKeys.signedUrl` from the 'Chosen names not in the docs' note and open_issues.

findings.quote: `queryKeys.notifications.*` or `.preferences(…)` — read `keys.ts`; add additively (with a test) if a key is missing
findings.problem: G4 1.7a defines `queryKeys.notifications.preferences(orgId)`; hedging invites a parallel key.
findings.fix: State `queryKeys.notifications.preferences(orgId)` and delete the 'add additively if missing' clause.

findings.quote: DESIGN §5 "Sign in or create an account with the email address the invitation was sent to"
findings.problem: No such sentence exists in docs/DESIGN.md (nor PLAN.md). DESIGN §5 'Getting accounts' item 1 only says the invite link is `https://APP_URL/invite/{token}` and the web page offers 'Open in app'. The invented quotation is used to justify the `shouldCreateUser: true` rule, making a step-4.1b decision look like a design requirement.
findings.fix: Replace with: `shouldCreateUser: true` when a `pending_invite_token` exists (an invited person may have no auth account yet — DESIGN §5 'Getting accounts' item 1 sends the invitation to an email, and `accept_invitation` creates the household/person on first acceptance; PLAN §9 gives mobile no signup screen). Keep the rule flagged as a 4.1b decision in notes/open_issues (already there).

findings.quote: "You are signed in as <email>. Your account is not linked to a church yet. Ask your church to invite you or to create your account." (DESIGN §10 wording)
findings.problem: DESIGN §10 wording is "Ask your church to invite you or create your account" (no 'to').
findings.fix: Quote verbatim: `Ask your church to invite you or create your account` and keep the two preceding sentences as 4.1b additions (not attributed to DESIGN).

findings.quote: Founder decision 9 (2026-09-03): "App display name Anacast; Android package id given as `com.Anacast.app` — record verbatim, recommend lowercase `com.anacast.app` … (founder to confirm; cannot change after first Play upload). Deep-link scheme can become `anacast`."
findings.problem: That text is the skeleton's paraphrase, not what HANDOFF.md records. HANDOFF's answer-9 row reads: "**`com.Anacast.app`** → display name **Anacast** … Recommendation: use lowercase `com.anacast.app` (package ids are conventionally lowercase and cannot change after the first Play upload) — founder to confirm." The agent is told to read HANDOFF first and will not find the quoted sentence.
findings.fix: Quote HANDOFF's row verbatim (as above) and attribute the scheme choice to orchestrator decision 5 rather than to the founder.

findings.quote: `@tanstack/query-async-storage-persister` and `@tanstack/react-query-persist-client` (pure JS; `expo install` passes them through unchanged, or `pnpm add` them at 5.102.x to match the catalog's react-query)
findings.problem: DESIGN §3 lists `@tanstack/query-async-storage-persister` 5.102.8 under 'Data (catalog)'; G1's 1.1 did not put it in the catalog (mobile-only). The prompt neither pins the exact version nor records the deviation.
findings.fix: Say: `pnpm add @tanstack/query-async-storage-persister@5.102.8 @tanstack/react-query-persist-client@5.102.8` (same version as the catalog's `@tanstack/react-query`, DESIGN §3); note in HANDOFF 'Deviations from plan' that DESIGN §3 placed the persister in the catalog but it is mobile-only so it lives in `apps/mobile/package.json`.

findings.quote: `pnpm add expo@~57.0.19` (the SDK pin itself, PLAN §3)
findings.problem: PLAN §3 / DESIGN §3 pin `expo` 57.0.19 exactly (no tilde); the other mobile pins with `~` are copied from the docs, this one is not.
findings.fix: Use `pnpm add expo@57.0.19` (exact, PLAN §3) and let every other version come from `npx expo install`.

findings.quote: validate `{ expo_push_token: token.data, platform: Platform.OS, device_name: Device.modelName ?? undefined }` with `registerPushDeviceSchema`
findings.problem: `push_platform` is `android | ios` (G2 1.2, DESIGN §4.1); `Platform.OS` also yields `web`/`windows`/`macos`, which the schema will reject at runtime with an opaque validation error.
findings.fix: Add: `if (Platform.OS !== 'android' && Platform.OS !== 'ios') return { status: 'unsupported' }` before the token request, and type `platform` as `'android' | 'ios'`.

findings.quote: a second grep for the old placeholder package id that PLAN §9 lists
findings.problem: The placeholder is `com.churchappcld.app` (PLAN §9, DESIGN §10); leaving it unnamed makes the consistency pass guesswork.
findings.fix: Write `git grep -n "com.churchappcld.app" docs README.md HANDOFF.md apps` explicitly, alongside the `churchapp://` grep.
